title: Weekly Planning Coach
prompt_text: Act as a weekly productivity coach. Reflect on the following input from my past week: {past_week_summary}. Based on that, generate a plan for the coming week, including top 3 goals, habits to track, and key lessons.

title: Time Blocking Scheduler
prompt_text: You are a time-blocking expert. I will give you my tasks for today: {task_list}. Arrange them into a realistic hourly schedule from 9AM-6PM with focus blocks, breaks, and buffer time.

title: Learn Anything 10x Faster
prompt_text: I want to learn {your_topic}. Create a 4-week learning roadmap using fast learning techniques like active recall, Feynman technique, spaced repetition, and real-world practice.

title: Daily Standup Reflector
prompt_text: Ask me: 1) What did I do yesterday? 2) What is the plan today? 3) What is blocking me? Then respond with encouragement and a focus reminder.

title: Eisenhower Prioritizer
prompt_text: Here is my current list of tasks: {task_list}. Categorize them into the Eisenhower matrix and suggest what I should Do, Schedule, Delegate, or Delete.

title: Digital Brain Architect
prompt_text: I want to build a second brain for {your_use_case} using Notion. Help me create a dashboard structure, templates, and tagging system.

title: Decision Clarity Sheet
prompt_text: Help me decide: {your_decision}. Ask me clarifying questions, list pros and cons, and help simulate possible outcomes.

title: Email Rewrite Assistant
prompt_text: Here is a messy email draft: {your_draft}. Rewrite it to be clear, concise, and polite, but still assertive.

title: Productivity Systems Generator
prompt_text: I am a {role_or_personality} who struggles with {problem}. Suggest a personal productivity system that suits me and helps solve this.

title: Anti-Burnout Planner
prompt_text: I am feeling overwhelmed. Help me redesign my weekly schedule for energy balance, rest, deep work, and recovery activities.

title: Personal OKRs Generator
prompt_text: Help me set personal OKRs for the next quarter around {focus_area}. I want 3 objectives, each with measurable key results.

title: Deep Work Mode Enabler
prompt_text: I need to focus deeply on {task}. Create a 2-hour deep work ritual with setup steps, distraction blockers, and a shutdown routine.

title: Digital Detox Planner
prompt_text: Build me a realistic 7-day digital detox plan that reduces my screen time without harming my work. Include boundaries, replacements, and daily check-ins.

title: Personal Manifesto Writer
prompt_text: Guide me through writing a 1-page personal manifesto about my values, identity, non-negotiables, and vision.

title: Creative Brainstorm Facilitator
prompt_text: Facilitate a brainstorming session for {problem_or_topic}. Give me 20 ideas, then group them into themes and suggest the top 3 to pursue first.

title: Communication Tone Adjuster
prompt_text: Rewrite this message in a {desired_tone} tone: {original_text}. Keep all key points but adapt voice and length.

title: Presentation Outline Builder
prompt_text: Create a 10-slide presentation outline on {topic} for {audience}. Include the title of each slide, the main point, and one supporting example.

title: Grant Proposal Drafting Assistant
prompt_text: Help me draft a grant proposal for {project}. Structure it with problem, impact, methodology, budget logic, and expected outcomes.

title: Weekly Theme Planner
prompt_text: Give me a weekly theme based on my priorities: {priorities}. Build a simple plan that keeps all major tasks aligned to that theme.

title: Creative Constraint Generator
prompt_text: I am stuck on {creative_task}. Give me 10 useful creative constraints that can make the work sharper, more original, and easier to finish.

title: Meeting Prep Snapshot
prompt_text: I have an upcoming meeting about {meeting_topic}. Help me prepare a one-page brief with goals, questions, risks, and desired outcomes.

title: Priority Funnel Designer
prompt_text: Help me reduce these priorities into one ranked list: {priority_list}. Show what to do now, later, delegate, or drop.

title: Focused Reading Plan
prompt_text: I want to deeply understand {topic_or_book}. Create a reading plan with sections to focus on, note prompts, and recall questions.

title: Strategic Pause Prompter
prompt_text: Before I act on this situation: {situation}, ask me the best reflection questions to slow down, see blind spots, and choose a better next move.

title: Bug Reproduction Assistant
prompt_text: Here is a bug report: {bug_description}. Create a minimal code snippet that reproduces this issue.

title: Code Review Coach
prompt_text: Review this code in {language}: {paste_code}. Point out style issues, performance concerns, and suggest improvements.

title: API Endpoint Designer
prompt_text: Design a REST API for {resource_description}, including endpoints, payload schemas, and HTTP methods.

title: Infrastructure-as-Code Generator
prompt_text: Create Terraform code to provision a {cloud_provider} setup with VPC, subnets, and an RDS instance.

title: Logging & Monitoring Setup
prompt_text: Recommend a logging and monitoring stack for {language_or_platform} services, including metrics, dashboards, and alerts.

title: Feature Flag Strategy
prompt_text: Outline a feature flag strategy for rolling out {feature_name}, including who toggles flags and a rollback plan.

title: OAuth Integration Example
prompt_text: Show how to integrate GitHub OAuth login in a Node.js and Express app, including callback handling and token storage.

title: Legacy API Wrapper Creator
prompt_text: Wrap this old XML-based API into a clean JSON REST interface in {language}.

title: Feature Roadmap Visualizer
prompt_text: Here are upcoming features: {list}. Create a quarterly roadmap with milestones and dependencies.

title: Cross-Browser Testing Plan
prompt_text: Recommend tools, frameworks, and test cases to cover Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and mobile browsers.

title: MVP Scope Critic
prompt_text: I have this startup idea: {idea}. Define the narrowest MVP that can validate demand, list what must stay in version one, what should be cut, and the success metric to watch first.

title: Positioning Angle Builder
prompt_text: For this product: {product}. Create three strong positioning angles based on the audience, the painful problem, the differentiator, and the clearest promise we can make.

title: Market Gap Scanner
prompt_text: Analyze this business idea: {idea}. Identify the customer problem, what alternatives exist today, what market gap may still be open, and what evidence I should collect next.

title: Founder Problem Interview Prep
prompt_text: I want to validate this startup problem: {problem}. Write 12 interview questions that uncover current behavior, workarounds, urgency, and willingness to pay without leading the user.

title: Feature Priority Matrix
prompt_text: Here is my product idea and feature list: {idea_and_features}. Rank the features into must-have, should-have, nice-to-have, and not-now based on user value, launch risk, and speed.

title: Landing Page Messaging Sprint
prompt_text: Use this product idea: {product}. Write a landing page messaging draft with headline, subheadline, problem, solution, proof, objection handling, and CTA.

title: Homepage Wireframe Prompt
prompt_text: For this website or SaaS offer: {offer}. Propose a homepage structure section by section, explaining what each section should communicate and why it belongs there.

title: Cold Outreach Personalizer
prompt_text: Write a short outreach email for {offer} to {recipient_type}. Personalize it based on this context: {context}. Keep it concise, specific, and easy to reply to.

title: Proposal Scoping Assistant
prompt_text: Create a client proposal for {service}. Include scope, deliverables, timeline, pricing logic, assumptions, and a next-step CTA in a clear structure.

title: Research Brief Generator
prompt_text: Turn this topic into a research brief: {topic}. Clarify the question, assumptions, required evidence, risks, and what a strong conclusion would need to prove.

title: Study Guide Compression Prompt
prompt_text: I need to learn this quickly: {topic}. Create a compressed study guide with the core ideas, memory hooks, practice questions, and the smallest set of things I must remember.

title: Scene Beat Builder
prompt_text: For this screenplay idea: {idea}. Build the next scene with the character goal, conflict, turn, emotional beat, and what should change by the end.
